content.title: United Therapeutics Price Strength Rating Jumps; Stock Soared 33% Last Week
content.summary: Shares of United Therapeutics stock shot up 33% on Sept. 2 to an all-time high after the company announced positive results for its drug, Tyvaso. Tyvaso treats patients with a chronic lung disease called idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.  Among its other key ratings United Therapeutics carries an 84 EPS Rating out of 99.  United Therapeutics develops treatments for heart diseases and cancer.
